# Functions 

## Internal functions 

These functions are called upon in the overarching function. The first function was designed to get index values based on sdmTMB models depending on the spatial scale examined. The second function is utilized to gather density estimates across an even spatial scale for plotting purposes. 

```{r Functions for analysis}

Pred_sdm_function = function(Pred_data = NA, model = NA, Mod_data = NA){
      ## Prediction ####
    Proj_df_years = replicate_df(Pred_data[,c("area_km2","lon","lat","depth_m", "group")], "year",
                                 unique(Mod_data$year)) #Repeat the prediction data frame for the years that were analyzed 
    predictions_All_TMB <- predict(model, newdata = Proj_df_years, return_tmb_object=T)

        index <- get_index(predictions_All_TMB, 
                           area = predictions_All_TMB$data$area_km2, 
                           bias_correct = TRUE)
        index = rbind(index, data.frame(year = 2020,
                                        est = NA,
                                        lwr = NA, 
                                        upr = NA, 
                                        log_est = NA,
                                        se = NA))
        index$group = Pred_data[1,]$group
        ggplot(index, aes(as.numeric(as.character(year)), est)) + 
          geom_line() +
          geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lwr, ymax = upr), alpha = 0.4) +
          xlab('Year') + ylab('Biomass estimate (kg)')
        return(list(Index = index,
               Pred = predictions_All_TMB$data))
    }

saveRDS(Pred_sdm_function, paste0(WD.1, "/Functions/Pred_sdm_function.rds"))


Dens_PM_func = function(Dens_data = NA,
                        scen = NA,
                        Proj_extent = NA,
                        OSW_shp = NA){
  # List to be filled 
    SP_dens = Dens_data
    SP_dens_ER = Dens_data %>%
      filter(group %in% "Entire region")
    
    group_dif_ER = list()
    gr_group_xy <- list()
    gr_group = list()
    gr_pred_group = list()
    group_dif = list()
    group_list = list()
    
    #Grab points for plotting - entire region 
    gr=st_bbox(SP_dens[SP_dens$scen=="All data",] %>%
                 st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"),
                          crs = st_crs("+proj=utm +zone=10 +datum=WGS84 +units=km"))) %>%
      st_make_grid(cellsize=.5, what='centers')%>%
      st_as_sf() %>%
      st_intersection(st_as_sfc((Proj_extent)))
    gr_xy <- st_coordinates(gr)

    #Grab points for plotting - OSW areas 
    for(i in 1:length(unique(OSW_shp$group))){ 
    #Create a data frame for each OSW area
      gr_group[[i]]=gr %>%
        st_intersection(st_as_sfc(OSW_shp[OSW_shp$group==unique(OSW_shp$group)[i],]))
      gr_group_xy[[i]] = st_coordinates(gr_group[[i]])
    }
    names(gr_group) = unique(OSW_shp$group)
    names(gr_group_xy) = unique(OSW_shp$group)

    

    for(i in 1:length(unique(scen$Scenario))){
          ### Part 1 - set up the data frame ####
          #Create dataframe of density where things are properly labeled and estimate is Exp
      df1 = SP_dens_ER %>%
        mutate(Exp = exp(est)) %>%
        rename(X = lon, Y= lat) %>%
        dplyr::select(X, Y, scen, Exp, year) %>%
        rename(Scenario = scen)
      #Create two data frames for the two different scenarios of concern 
      df_scen =df1 %>%
        filter(Scenario == unique(scen$Scenario)[i]) %>%
        select(X,Y,Exp,year)
      colnames(df_scen) = c("X", "Y", unique(scen$Scenario)[i], "year")
      df_all_data = df1 %>%
        filter(Scenario == "All data") %>%
        select(X,Y,Exp,year) %>%
        rename("All data" = Exp)   
      #Merge the two dataframes together 
      DF_dif = merge(df_all_data, df_scen, by = c("X", "Y", "year"))
      group_dif_ER[[i]] = DF_dif %>% 
        mutate(Dif = .[[5]]-.[[4]],
               scen = unique(scen$Scenario)[i]) 
      colnames(group_dif_ER[[i]]) = c("X","Y","year", "All data", "Est", "Dif", "scen")
    }
    
    sp_Dif = bind_rows(group_dif_ER) #Want to save this as it has the estimates and the dif for each scneario option 
    
    #Now calculate the density performance metrics 
    sp_PM = sp_Dif %>%
      mutate(ID = paste0(X,"_",Y)) %>%
      group_by(ID, scen) %>%
      summarise(RMSE = sqrt((sum((Dif)^2))/length(unique(sp_Dif$year))),
                MAE = abs(sum(Dif))/length(unique(sp_Dif$year))) %>%
      separate(ID, into = c("X", "Y"), sep = "\\_")%>%
      mutate(X = as.numeric(as.character(X)),
             Y = as.numeric(as.character(Y)))
    
    gr_pred_PM = bind_rows(lapply(split(sp_PM, sp_PM$scen), function(x){
      pred_points <- x %>%
      dplyr::select(X,Y) %>% as.matrix()
      nns <- nn2(pred_points,gr_xy[,c("X", "Y")],k=1)$nn.idx
      gr_pred <- gr_xy %>% as_tibble() %>% mutate(RMSE=x$RMSE[nns],
                                                  MAE = x$MAE[nns])
      gr_pred$scen = x$scen[1]
      return(gr_pred)
      }))

    gr_pred_PM_OSW = bind_rows(lapply(split(sp_PM, sp_PM$scen), function(x){
      scen_list = list()
      for(i in 1:length(gr_group_xy)){
        pred_points <- x %>%
          dplyr::select(X,Y) %>% as.matrix()
        nns <- nn2(pred_points,gr_group_xy[[i]][,c("X","Y")],k=1)$nn.idx
        gr_pred <- gr_group_xy[[i]] %>% as_tibble() %>% mutate(RMSE=x$RMSE[nns],
                                                               MAE = x$MAE[nns])
        gr_pred$scen = x$scen[1]
        gr_pred$OSW = names(gr_group_xy)[i]
        scen_list[[i]] = gr_pred
        }
      return(bind_rows(scen_list))
      }))
    return(list(Density_PM_ER = gr_pred_PM,
                Density_PM_OSW = gr_pred_PM_OSW,
                Density_PM_all = sp_PM,
                Density_Dif = sp_Dif))
}
saveRDS(Dens_PM_func, paste0(WD.1, "/Functions/Dens_PM_func.rds"))


Dens_PM_func_DG = function(Dens_data = NA,
                        scen = NA,

    gr_pred_group = list()
    group_dif = list()
    group_list = list()
    
    #Grab points for plotting - entire region 
    gr=st_bbox(SP_dens[SP_dens$scen=="All data",] %>%
                 st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"),
                          crs = st_crs("+proj=utm +zone=10 +datum=WGS84 +units=km"))) %>%
      st_make_grid(cellsize=.5, what='centers')%>%
      st_as_sf() %>%
      st_intersection(st_as_sfc((Proj_extent)))
    gr_xy <- st_coordinates(gr)

    #Grab points for plotting - OSW areas 
    for(i in 1:length(unique(OSW_shp$group))){ 
    #Create a data frame for each OSW area
      gr_group[[i]]=gr %>%
        st_intersection(st_as_sfc(OSW_shp[OSW_shp$group==unique(OSW_shp$group)[i],]))
      gr_group_xy[[i]] = st_coordinates(gr_group[[i]])
    }
    names(gr_group) = unique(OSW_shp$group)
    names(gr_group_xy) = unique(OSW_shp$group)

    

    for(i in 1:length(unique(scen$Scenario))){
          ### Part 1 - set up the data frame ####
          #Create dataframe of density where things are properly labeled and estimate is Exp
      df1 = SP_dens_ER %>%
        mutate(Exp = Est) %>%
        rename(X = lon, Y= lat) %>%
        dplyr::select(X, Y, scen, Exp, year) %>%
        rename(Scenario = scen)
      #Create two data frames for the two different scenarios of concern 
      df_scen =df1 %>%
        filter(Scenario == unique(scen$Scenario)[i]) %>%
        select(X,Y,Exp,year)
      colnames(df_scen) = c("X", "Y", unique(scen$Scenario)[i], "year")
      df_all_data = df1 %>%
        filter(Scenario == "All data") %>%
        select(X,Y,Exp,year) %>%
        rename("All data" = Exp)   
      #Merge the two dataframes together 
      DF_dif = merge(df_all_data, df_scen, by = c("X", "Y", "year"))
      group_dif_ER[[i]] = DF_dif %>% 
        mutate(Dif = .[[5]]-.[[4]],
               scen = unique(scen$Scenario)[i]) 
      colnames(group_dif_ER[[i]]) = c("X","Y","year", "All data", "Est", "Dif", "scen")
    }
    
    sp_Dif = bind_rows(group_dif_ER) #Want to save this as it has the estimates and the dif for each scneario option 
    
    #Now calculate the density performance metrics 
    sp_PM = sp_Dif %>%
      mutate(ID = paste0(X,"_",Y)) %>%
      group_by(ID, scen) %>%
      summarise(RMSE = sqrt((sum((Dif)^2))/length(unique(sp_Dif$year))),
                MAE = abs(sum(Dif))/length(unique(sp_Dif$year))) %>%
      separate(ID, into = c("X", "Y"), sep = "\\_")%>%
      mutate(X = as.numeric(as.character(X)),
             Y = as.numeric(as.character(Y)))
    
    gr_pred_PM = bind_rows(lapply(split(sp_PM, sp_PM$scen), function(x){
      pred_points <- x %>%
      dplyr::select(X,Y) %>% as.matrix()
      nns <- nn2(pred_points,gr_xy[,c("X", "Y")],k=1)$nn.idx
      gr_pred <- gr_xy %>% as_tibble() %>% mutate(RMSE=x$RMSE[nns],
                                                  MAE = x$MAE[nns])
      gr_pred$scen = x$scen[1]
      return(gr_pred)
      }))

    gr_pred_PM_OSW = bind_rows(lapply(split(sp_PM, sp_PM$scen), function(x){
      scen_list = list()
      for(i in 1:length(gr_group_xy)){
        pred_points <- x %>%
          dplyr::select(X,Y) %>% as.matrix()
        nns <- nn2(pred_points,gr_group_xy[[i]][,c("X","Y")],k=1)$nn.idx
        gr_pred <- gr_group_xy[[i]] %>% as_tibble() %>% mutate(RMSE=x$RMSE[nns],
                                                               MAE = x$MAE[nns])
        gr_pred$scen = x$scen[1]
        gr_pred$OSW = names(gr_group_xy)[i]
        scen_list[[i]] = gr_pred
        }
      return(bind_rows(scen_list))
      }))
    return(list(Density_PM_ER = gr_pred_PM,
                Density_PM_OSW = gr_pred_PM_OSW,
                Density_PM_all = sp_PM,
                Density_Dif = sp_Dif))
}
```

## Large Projection Function 

```{r ProjectionFunction}

PROJ_Func = function(scen = NA, #Data frame of the different scenarios of interest - column 1 is the scenario, column 2 is the terminal year where sampling occurred in the OSW area 
                     prediction_data = NA, #Data frame for predictions of the sdmTMB model - no years included at the moment
                     model_data = NA, #Data for the species for fitting the models (in this case the WCGBTS data)
                     OSW_shp = NA,#SF file (polygon) for the different areas of interest (ensure that there is a column identifying them - here it is called "group")
                     S.edge = NA,
                     M.edge = NA,
                     Start.year = NA,
                     Term.year = NA, #The terminal year to assess - only pull out the density for this year 
                     Proj_extent = NA, #Shapefile or data frame to trim the projection
                     c.off = NA){ #cutoff for the INLA mesh
  ################################################################################################
  #### Gather the prediction data frames - specifically separate the individual areas        ####
  ################################################################################################
  
  #The entire prediction data frame is supplied to the function, but we need to specify the data frames for each area of interest
  
  #This for loop goes through and pulls out the prediction data inside each area of interest - in this case the four OSW areas 
  Proj_df_OSW=list(NA)
  for(x in 1:length(unique(OSW_shp$group))){
    groups = unique(OSW_shp$group)
    OSW_a=OSW_shp%>%
      filter(group==groups[x])
    
    OSW_b=st_intersection(prediction_data %>% 
                            st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"),
                                     crs = st_crs("+proj=utm +zone=10 +datum=WGS84 +units=km")), OSW_a)
    OSW_b$lon = st_coordinates(OSW_b)[,1]
    OSW_b$lat = st_coordinates(OSW_b)[,2]
    
    Proj_df_OSW[[x]] = data.frame(OSW_b)
    Proj_df_OSW[[x]]$group = unique(OSW_shp$group)[x]#Make sure group is labeled correctly 
  }  
  names(Proj_df_OSW) = unique(OSW_shp$group)#Name each element of the list by the OSW area
  
  ## Now we also want to evaluate on how indices could change if there was evidence to assess and manage these stocks as a north/south west coast stock
  Proj_df_OSW$North = prediction_data %>% select(lon, lat) %>%
    st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"),
             crs = "+proj=utm +zone=10 +datum=WGS84 +units=km") %>%
    st_transform(crs = st_crs("+proj=longlat + datum=WGS84 + no_dfs")) %>% 
    st_coordinates() %>% as_tibble() %>% rename(Lon_dd = X, Lat_dd = Y) %>%
    cbind(prediction_data) %>%
    filter(Lat_dd >=40.16667) %>% #40.10 management line for the North South Division 
    mutate(group = "North")
  
  Proj_df_OSW$South = prediction_data %>% select(lon, lat) %>%
    st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"),
             crs = "+proj=utm +zone=10 +datum=WGS84 +units=km") %>%
    st_transform(crs = st_crs("+proj=longlat + datum=WGS84 + no_dfs")) %>% 
    st_coordinates() %>% as_tibble() %>% rename(Lon_dd = X, Lat_dd = Y) %>%
    cbind(prediction_data) %>%
    filter(Lat_dd <40.16667) %>% #40.10 management line for the North South Division 
    mutate(group = "South")
  ################################################################################################
  #### Fit a model with all the data across all years                                         ####
  ################################################################################################
  # sdmTMB is utilized here, for this we need to include a mesh and the model data 
  print(paste0("Starting prediction for all years and all data for ", model_data$common_name[1]))
  OG_mesh1 = fmesher::fm_mesh_2d_inla(loc = cbind(model_data$lon, model_data$lat),
                                      max.edge = c(S.edge,M.edge),offset = c(25, 50),
                                      cutoff = c.off)
  OG_mesh = make_mesh(model_data, xy_cols = c("lon", "lat"), mesh = OG_mesh1)
  plot(OG_mesh)
  # OG_mesh = make_mesh(model_data, xy_cols = c("lon", "lat"),
  #                     cutoff = c.off,
  #                     type = "cutoff")#Create the original mesh utilizing all data
  ## Fit the model - currently only including spatial for test purposes ####
  #Ideally, fit the original model first and then use it as an input into the function?
  start = Sys.time()
  Mod1 = tryCatch({ 
    sdmTMB(data = model_data,
           formula = cpue_kg_km2 ~ as.factor(year) + s(depth_m,k=3),#Currently including year and depth as variables to consider
           mesh = OG_mesh,
           time = "year",
           #spatiotemporal = "iid",
           family = tweedie(link = "log"),#Tweedie distribution for the moment 
           spatial = "on",#list("on","on"),
           spatiotemporal = "IID",#list("off","IID"),
    )}, error = function(e) NA)
  print(Sys.time()-start)
  saveRDS(Mod1, paste0(WD.1, "/sdmTMB_func/Model_",model_data$common_name[1],"_",OSW_shp$Scenario[1],Sys.Date(),"_All_Data.rds"))
  # Model check ####
  sanity(Mod1)
  print(tidy(Mod1, conf.int = T))
  # Residual check ####
  model_data$resid = residuals(Mod1, type ='mle-mvn')
  #model_data$resid2 = residuals(Mod1, type ='mle-mvn', model = 2)
  #Simulate residuals for DHARMA analysis
  start = Sys.time()
  s_mod1 <- simulate(Mod1, nsim = 1000, type = "mle-mvn")
  print(Sys.time()-start)

  sum(s_mod1 == 0)/length(s_mod1); nrow(model_data[model_data$cpue_kg_km2==0,])/nrow(model_data)#Check that it can handle the # of zeros
  r_mod1 = dharma_residuals(s_mod1, Mod1, return_DHARMa = T)
  pdf(file = paste0(WD.1, "/Plots/Resid/",model_data$common_name[1],Sys.Date(),"_DHARMa_Residuals_plots.pdf"))
  plot(r_mod1)
  DHARMa::testResiduals(r_mod1)
  DHARMa::testZeroInflation(r_mod1)
  dev.off()
  # qqplot1=ggplot(model_data, aes(sample = resid)) + stat_qq() + stat_qq_line()+
  #   theme_classic()+
  #   labs(title = paste0(model_data$common_name[1], ": All data"))
  # ggsave(paste0(WD.1, "/Plots/Resid/",model_data$common_name[1],"_all_data_qqplot.png"),
  #        qqplot1,
  #        height = 4, width = 4, units = "in")
  #MCMC-based residuals - much slower to run 
  # set.seed(123)
  # samps <- sdmTMBextra::predict_mle_mcmc(Mod1, mcmc_warmup = 100, mcmc_iter = 101)#Currently including a short number of warmup and iterations - just given that it is a trial option 
  # r <- residuals(Mod1, "mle-mcmc", mcmc_samples = samps)
  # qqnorm(r)
  # abline(a = 0, b = 1)
  
  # Spatial check ####
  Mod1_spatial=ggplot() +
    scale_colour_gradient2() +
    geom_point(data = model_data, aes(lon, lat, col = resid),size=.1) +
    facet_wrap(~year) +
    coord_fixed()+
    theme_classic()+
    theme(legend.title = element_blank())
  
  ggsave(paste0(WD.1, "/Plots/Resid/",model_data$common_name[1],Sys.Date(),"_all_data_spatial.png"),
         Mod1_spatial,
         height = 10, width = 10, units = "in")
  
  #   Mod1_spatialb=ggplot() +
  #   scale_colour_gradient2() +
  #   geom_point(data = model_data, aes(lon, lat, col = resid2),size=.1) +
  #   facet_wrap(~year) +
  #   coord_fixed()+
  #   theme_classic()+
  #   theme(legend.title = element_blank())
  # 
  # ggsave(paste0(WD.1, "/Plots/Resid/",model_data$common_name[1],"_all_data_spatial_Gamma.png"),
  #        Mod1_spatialb,
  #        height = 10, width = 10, units = "in")
  
  ############################
  ### Predictions         ####
  ############################
  
  #Entire region
  Entire_region_all_y = Pred_sdm_function(Pred_data = prediction_data,
                                          model = Mod1,
                                          Mod_data = model_data)
  #OSW areas - separately
  OSW_all_y=list(NA)
  for(j in 1:length(Proj_df_OSW)){
    Pred_data1 = Proj_df_OSW[[j]]
    #Pred_data1$group == unique(OSW_shp$group)[j]
    OSW_all_y[[j]] = Pred_sdm_function(Pred_data = Pred_data1,
                                       model = Mod1,
                                       Mod_data = model_data)
  }
  # OSW areas - all together
  Proj_df_OSW_all = bind_rows(Proj_df_OSW[unique(OSW_shp$group)])
  Proj_df_OSW_all$group = "OSW"
  OSW_region_all_y = Pred_sdm_function(Pred_data = Proj_df_OSW_all,
                                       model = Mod1,
                                       Mod_data = model_data)
  
  ## Combine all the data together for plotting and analysis ##
  Index_all = rbind(Entire_region_all_y$Index, #Get all the index values together across the different regions 
                    bind_rows(lapply(OSW_all_y, '[[',1)),
                    OSW_region_all_y$Index)
  Index_all$scen = "All data"
  Density_all = rbind(Entire_region_all_y$Pred, #Get all the density estimates across the different regions 
                      bind_rows(lapply(OSW_all_y, '[[',2)),
                      OSW_region_all_y$Pred)
  Density_all[Density_all$year == Term.year,]
  Density_all$scen = "All data"
  
  ################################################################################################
  #### Look at the different proposed scenarios                                               ####
  ################################################################################################
  ### Create lists for the different data frames ####
  Index_OSW = list(NA)
  Density_OSW = list(NA)
  Scen_mod = list(NA)
  
  ### For loop to go through the different scenarios - may be a better option to think through ####
  
  for(i in 1:nrow(scen)){
    print(paste0("Starting model and prediction for scenario this is missing ", scen[i,]$Scenario," of data"))
    ##############################
    ## Data set up 
    ##############################
    # Start by removing data inside the areas of interest for the different scenario years 
    if(scen[i,]$Year %in% Start.year){
      pt2a = data.frame(st_intersection(st_as_sf(data.frame(model_data), coords = c("lon", "lat"),
                                                 crs = "+proj=utm +zone=10 +datum=WGS84 +units=km"), 
                                        OSW_shp))
      pt.mod = model_data[!model_data$trawl_id %in% pt2a$trawl_id,]
    }else{#If you are only removing the data for a certain number of years 
      pt1 = model_data[model_data$year %in%  c(Start.year:scen[i,]$Year),]#Years that still sample the areas of interest 
      pt2 = model_data[!model_data$year %in% c(Start.year:scen[i,]$Year),]#Years to remove samples inside the OSW 
      pt2a = data.frame(st_intersection(st_as_sf(data.frame(pt2), coords = c("lon", "lat"),
                                                 crs = "+proj=utm +zone=10 +datum=WGS84 +units=km"), 
                                        OSW_shp))
      # ggplot(coast_outline)+
      #   geom_sf()+
      #   geom_point(data = pt2[!pt2$trawl_id %in% pt2a$trawl_id,], aes(x = lon, y=lat), size = .2)+
      #   geom_sf(data = OSW_shp, fill = 'transparent', colour = 'black', lwd = .3)
      # 
      # ggplot(coast_outline)+
      #   geom_sf()+
      #   geom_point(data = model_data[model_data$year==2023,], aes(x = lon, y=lat), size = .2)+
      #   geom_sf(data = OSW_shp, fill = 'transparent', colour = 'black', lwd = .3)
      
      pt.mod = rbind(pt1, 
                     pt2[!pt2$trawl_id %in% pt2a$trawl_id,]) #Create a data frame that has removed the OSW sample areas for 
      
      # ggplot(coast_outline)+
      #   geom_sf()+
      #   geom_point(data = pt.mod[pt.mod$year==2022,], aes(x = lon, y=lat), size = .2)+
      #   geom_sf(data = OSW_shp, fill = 'transparent', colour = 'black', lwd = .3)
    }
    
    ##############################
    ## Fit model to the new data 
    ##############################
    Mod2 = tryCatch({
      sdmTMB(data = pt.mod,
             formula = formula(Mod1),
             mesh = make_mesh(pt.mod, xy_cols = c("lon", "lat"), mesh = OG_mesh$mesh),
             family = Mod1$family,
             time = Mod1$time,
             spatiotemporal = Mod1$spatiotemporal,
             spatial = Mod1$spatial#,
           #spatial = list("on","on"),
           #spatiotemporal = list("off","IID")#,
          #   spatiotemporal = "IID"
      )},
      error = function(e) NA)
    saveRDS(Mod2, paste0(WD.1, "/sdmTMB_func/Model_",pt.mod$common_name[1],"_",OSW_shp$Scenario[1],"_",scen$Scenario[i],Sys.Date(),".rds"))
    #Residual check - have this save to a folder somewhere?
    sanity(Mod2)
    tidy(Mod2, conf.int = T)
    # Residual check ####
  pt.mod$resid = residuals(Mod2, type ='mle-mvn')
  #pt.mod$resid2 = residuals(Mod2, type ='mle-mvn', model = 2)
  #Simulate residuals for DHARMA analysis
  start = Sys.time()
  s_Mod2 <- simulate(Mod2, nsim = 1000, type = "mle-mvn")
  print(Sys.time()-start)

  sum(s_Mod2 == 0)/length(s_Mod2); nrow(pt.mod[pt.mod$cpue_kg_km2==0,])/nrow(pt.mod)#Check that it can handle the # of zeros
  r_Mod2 = dharma_residuals(s_Mod2, Mod2, return_DHARMa = T)
  pdf(file = paste0(WD.1, "/Plots/Resid/",pt.mod$common_name[1],"_DHARMa_Residuals_plots_",OSW_shp$Scenario[1],"_",scen$Scenario[i],Sys.Date(),".pdf"))
  plot(r_Mod2)
  DHARMa::testResiduals(r_Mod2)
  DHARMa::testZeroInflation(r_Mod2)
  dev.off()
    #MCMC-based residuals - much slower to run 
    # set.seed(123)
    # samps <- sdmTMBextra::predict_mle_mcmc(Mod2, mcmc_warmup = 100, mcmc_iter = 101)#Currently including a short number of warmup and iterations - just given that it is a trial option 
    # r <- residuals(Mod2, "mle-mcmc", mcmc_samples = samps)
    # qqnorm(r)
    # abline(a = 0, b = 1)
    
    # Spatial check ####
    OSW_model=ggplot(data = pt.mod, aes(lon, lat, col = resid)) +
      scale_colour_gradient2() +
      geom_point(size=.1) +
      facet_wrap(~year) +
      coord_fixed()+
      theme_classic()+
      theme(legend.title = element_blank())
    
    ggsave(paste0(WD.1, "/Plots/Resid/",pt.mod$common_name[1],"_",OSW_shp$Scenario[1],"_",scen$Scenario[i],Sys.Date(),"_spatial.png"),
           OSW_model,
           height = 10, width = 10, units = "in")

    #     OSW_modelb=ggplot(data = pt.mod, aes(lon, lat, col = resid2)) +
    #   scale_colour_gradient2() +
    #   geom_point(size=.1) +
    #   facet_wrap(~year) +
    #   coord_fixed()+
    #   theme_classic()+
    #   theme(legend.title = element_blank())
    # 
    # ggsave(paste0(WD.1, "/Plots/Resid/",pt.mod$common_name[1],"_",OSW_shp$Scenario[1],"_",scen$Scenario[i],"_spatial_gamma.png"),
    #        OSW_modelb,
    #        height = 10, width = 10, units = "in")
    
    ##############################
    ## Predictions 
    ##############################
    #Entire region 
    Entire_region_OSW_y = Pred_sdm_function(Pred_data = prediction_data,
                                            model = Mod2,
                                            Mod_data = pt.mod)
    #OSW areas - separately
    OSW_missing_y=list(NA)
    for(j in 1:length(Proj_df_OSW)){
      Pred_data1 = Proj_df_OSW[[j]]
      #Pred_data1$group == unique(OSW_shp$group)[j]
      OSW_missing_y[[j]] = Pred_sdm_function(Pred_data = Pred_data1,
                                             model = Mod2,
                                             Mod_data = pt.mod)
    }
    # OSW areas - all together
    OSW_region_missing_y = Pred_sdm_function(Pred_data = Proj_df_OSW_all,
                                             model = Mod2,
                                             Mod_data = pt.mod)
    
    ##############################
    ## Combine predictions together  
    ##############################
    Index_OSW[[i]] = rbind(Entire_region_OSW_y$Index, #Get all the index values together across the different regions 
                           bind_rows(lapply(OSW_missing_y, '[[',1)),
                           OSW_region_missing_y$Index)
    Index_OSW[[i]]$scen = scen[i,]$Scenario
    Density_OSW_df = rbind(Entire_region_OSW_y$Pred, #Get all the density estimates across the different regions 
                           bind_rows(lapply(OSW_missing_y, '[[',2)),
                           OSW_region_missing_y$Pred)
    Density_OSW[[i]] = Density_OSW_df#[Density_OSW_df$year == Term.year,]
    Density_OSW[[i]]$scen = scen[i,]$Scenario
    
  }
  ##############################
  ## Performance metrics for index values 
  ##############################
  print("Starting performance metrics for the index values")
  SP_Index = rbind(Index_all,bind_rows(Index_OSW[1:length(Index_OSW)]))#Combine all the regions together 
  SP_Index = SP_Index %>% 
    mutate(CI = upr-lwr) #Calculate the CI for each year 
  SP_term_PM = bind_rows(lapply(split(SP_Index, SP_Index$group), function(x){ #grab the performance metrics 
    x %>%
      group_by(group, scen) %>%
      dplyr::filter(year %in% Term.year) %>%
      mutate(CI_perc = ((CI - SP_Index[SP_Index$year ==Term.year &
                                         SP_Index$scen == "All data" &
                                         SP_Index$group %in% x$group,]$CI)/
                          ((CI + SP_Index[SP_Index$year ==Term.year &
                                            SP_Index$scen == "All data" &
                                            SP_Index$group %in% x$group,]$CI)/2))*100,
             est_RMSE = sqrt(((est - SP_Index[SP_Index$year ==Term.year &
                                                SP_Index$scen == "All data" &
                                                SP_Index$group %in% x$group,]$est))^2)#,
      )
  })) %>%
    dplyr::select(group, scen, CI_perc, est_RMSE)
  
  #########################################
  ## Performance metrics for density values 
  #########################################
  #Create lists/vectors to be filled in later 
  print("Starting performance metrics for the density estimates")
  Dens_func_values = Dens_PM_func(Dens_data = rbind(Density_all,bind_rows(Density_OSW[1:length(Density_OSW)])),
                                  Proj_extent = Proj_extent,
                                  scen = scen,
                                  OSW_shp = OSW_shp)

  #######################################################################################
  return(list(Index = SP_Index,
              Ind_pm = SP_term_PM,
              Density = rbind(Density_all,bind_rows(Density_OSW[1:length(Density_OSW)])),
              Dens_PM_ER = Dens_func_values$Density_PM_ER,
              Density_PM_OSW = Dens_func_values$Density_PM_OSW,
              Density_PM_all = Dens_func_values$Density_PM_all,
              Density_Dif = Dens_func_values$Density_Dif
              # Dif_Dens = sp_Dif,
              # Dens_PM = sp_PM
  ))
}
saveRDS(PROJ_Func, paste0(WD.1, "/Functions/PROJ_Func.rds"))

PROJ_Func_NoST = function(scen = NA, #Data frame of the different scenarios of interest - column 1 is the scenario, column 2 is the terminal year where sampling occurred in the OSW area 
                     prediction_data = NA, #Data frame for predictions of the sdmTMB model - no years included at the moment
                     model_data = NA, #Data for the species for fitting the models (in this case the WCGBTS data)
                     OSW_shp = NA,#SF file (polygon) for the different areas of interest (ensure that there is a column identifying them - here it is called "group")
                     S.edge = NA,
                     M.edge = NA,
                     Start.year = NA,
                     Term.year = NA, #The terminal year to assess - only pull out the density for this year 
                     Proj_extent = NA, #Shapefile or data frame to trim the projection
                     c.off = NA){ #cutoff for the INLA mesh
  ################################################################################################
  #### Gather the prediction data frames - specifically separate the individual areas        ####
  ################################################################################################
  
  #The entire prediction data frame is supplied to the function, but we need to specify the data frames for each area of interest
  
  #This for loop goes through and pulls out the prediction data inside each area of interest - in this case the four OSW areas 
  Proj_df_OSW=list(NA)
  for(x in 1:length(unique(OSW_shp$group))){
    groups = unique(OSW_shp$group)
    OSW_a=OSW_shp%>%
      filter(group==groups[x])
    
    OSW_b=st_intersection(prediction_data %>% 
                            st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"),
                                     crs = st_crs("+proj=utm +zone=10 +datum=WGS84 +units=km")), OSW_a)
    OSW_b$lon = st_coordinates(OSW_b)[,1]
    OSW_b$lat = st_coordinates(OSW_b)[,2]
    
    Proj_df_OSW[[x]] = data.frame(OSW_b)
    Proj_df_OSW[[x]]$group = unique(OSW_shp$group)[x]#Make sure group is labeled correctly 
  }  
  names(Proj_df_OSW) = unique(OSW_shp$group)#Name each element of the list by the OSW area
  
  ## Now we also want to evaluate on how indices could change if there was evidence to assess and manage these stocks as a north/south west coast stock
  Proj_df_OSW$North = prediction_data %>% select(lon, lat) %>%
    st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"),
             crs = "+proj=utm +zone=10 +datum=WGS84 +units=km") %>%
    st_transform(crs = st_crs("+proj=longlat + datum=WGS84 + no_dfs")) %>% 
    st_coordinates() %>% as_tibble() %>% rename(Lon_dd = X, Lat_dd = Y) %>%
    cbind(prediction_data) %>%
    filter(Lat_dd >=40.16667) %>% #40.10 management line for the North South Division 
    mutate(group = "North")
  
  Proj_df_OSW$South = prediction_data %>% select(lon, lat) %>%
    st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"),
             crs = "+proj=utm +zone=10 +datum=WGS84 +units=km") %>%
    st_transform(crs = st_crs("+proj=longlat + datum=WGS84 + no_dfs")) %>% 
    st_coordinates() %>% as_tibble() %>% rename(Lon_dd = X, Lat_dd = Y) %>%
    cbind(prediction_data) %>%
    filter(Lat_dd <40.16667) %>% #40.10 management line for the North South Division 
    mutate(group = "South")
  ################################################################################################
  #### Fit a model with all the data across all years                                         ####
  ################################################################################################
  # sdmTMB is utilized here, for this we need to include a mesh and the model data 
  print(paste0("Starting prediction for all years and all data for ", model_data$common_name[1]))
  OG_mesh1 = fmesher::fm_mesh_2d_inla(loc = cbind(model_data$lon, model_data$lat),
                                      max.edge = c(S.edge,M.edge),offset = c(25, 50),
                                      cutoff = c.off)
  OG_mesh = make_mesh(model_data, xy_cols = c("lon", "lat"), mesh = OG_mesh1)
  plot(OG_mesh)
  # OG_mesh = make_mesh(model_data, xy_cols = c("lon", "lat"),
  #                     cutoff = c.off,
  #                     type = "cutoff")#Create the original mesh utilizing all data
  ## Fit the model - currently only including spatial for test purposes ####
  #Ideally, fit the original model first and then use it as an input into the function?
  start = Sys.time()
  Mod1 = tryCatch({ 
    sdmTMB(data = model_data,
           formula = cpue_kg_km2 ~ as.factor(year) + s(depth_m,k=3),#Currently including year and depth as variables to consider
           mesh = OG_mesh,
           time = "year",
           #spatiotemporal = "iid",
           family = tweedie(link = "log"),#Tweedie distribution for the moment 
           spatial = "on",#list("on","on"),
           spatiotemporal = "off"#list("off","IID"),
    )}, error = function(e) NA)
  print(Sys.time()-start)
  saveRDS(Mod1, paste0(WD.1, "/sdmTMB_func/Model_",model_data$common_name[1],"_",OSW_shp$Scenario[1],Sys.Date(),"_All_Data_NoST.rds"))
  # Model check ####
  sanity(Mod1)
  print(tidy(Mod1, conf.int = T))
  # Residual check ####
  model_data$resid = residuals(Mod1, type ='mle-mvn')
  #model_data$resid2 = residuals(Mod1, type ='mle-mvn', model = 2)
  #Simulate residuals for DHARMA analysis
  start = Sys.time()
  s_mod1 <- simulate(Mod1, nsim = 1000, type = "mle-mvn")
  print(Sys.time()-start)

  sum(s_mod1 == 0)/length(s_mod1); nrow(model_data[model_data$cpue_kg_km2==0,])/nrow(model_data)#Check that it can handle the # of zeros
  r_mod1 = dharma_residuals(s_mod1, Mod1, return_DHARMa = T)
  pdf(file = paste0(WD.1, "/Plots/Resid/",model_data$common_name[1],Sys.Date(),"_DHARMa_Residuals_plots_NoST.pdf"))
  plot(r_mod1)
  DHARMa::testResiduals(r_mod1)
  DHARMa::testZeroInflation(r_mod1)
  dev.off()
  # qqplot1=ggplot(model_data, aes(sample = resid)) + stat_qq() + stat_qq_line()+
  #   theme_classic()+
  #   labs(title = paste0(model_data$common_name[1], ": All data"))
  # ggsave(paste0(WD.1, "/Plots/Resid/",model_data$common_name[1],"_all_data_qqplot.png"),
  #        qqplot1,
  #        height = 4, width = 4, units = "in")
  #MCMC-based residuals - much slower to run 
  # set.seed(123)
  # samps <- sdmTMBextra::predict_mle_mcmc(Mod1, mcmc_warmup = 100, mcmc_iter = 101)#Currently including a short number of warmup and iterations - just given that it is a trial option 
  # r <- residuals(Mod1, "mle-mcmc", mcmc_samples = samps)
  # qqnorm(r)
  # abline(a = 0, b = 1)
  
  # Spatial check ####
  Mod1_spatial=ggplot() +
    scale_colour_gradient2() +
    geom_point(data = model_data, aes(lon, lat, col = resid),size=.1) +
    facet_wrap(~year) +
    coord_fixed()+
    theme_classic()+
    theme(legend.title = element_blank())
  
  ggsave(paste0(WD.1, "/Plots/Resid/",model_data$common_name[1],Sys.Date(),"_all_data_spatial_NoST.png"),
         Mod1_spatial,
         height = 10, width = 10, units = "in")
  
  #   Mod1_spatialb=ggplot() +
  #   scale_colour_gradient2() +
  #   geom_point(data = model_data, aes(lon, lat, col = resid2),size=.1) +
  #   facet_wrap(~year) +
  #   coord_fixed()+
  #   theme_classic()+
  #   theme(legend.title = element_blank())
  # 
  # ggsave(paste0(WD.1, "/Plots/Resid/",model_data$common_name[1],"_all_data_spatial_Gamma.png"),
  #        Mod1_spatialb,
  #        height = 10, width = 10, units = "in")
  
  ############################
  ### Predictions         ####
  ############################
  
  #Entire region
  Entire_region_all_y = Pred_sdm_function(Pred_data = prediction_data,
                                          model = Mod1,
                                          Mod_data = model_data)
  #OSW areas - separately
  OSW_all_y=list(NA)
  for(j in 1:length(Proj_df_OSW)){
    Pred_data1 = Proj_df_OSW[[j]]
    #Pred_data1$group == unique(OSW_shp$group)[j]
    OSW_all_y[[j]] = Pred_sdm_function(Pred_data = Pred_data1,
                                       model = Mod1,
                                       Mod_data = model_data)
  }
  # OSW areas - all together
  Proj_df_OSW_all = bind_rows(Proj_df_OSW[unique(OSW_shp$group)])
  Proj_df_OSW_all$group = "OSW"
  OSW_region_all_y = Pred_sdm_function(Pred_data = Proj_df_OSW_all,
                                       model = Mod1,
                                       Mod_data = model_data)
  
  ## Combine all the data together for plotting and analysis ##
  Index_all = rbind(Entire_region_all_y$Index, #Get all the index values together across the different regions 
                    bind_rows(lapply(OSW_all_y, '[[',1)),
                    OSW_region_all_y$Index)
  Index_all$scen = "All data"
  Density_all = rbind(Entire_region_all_y$Pred, #Get all the density estimates across the different regions 
                      bind_rows(lapply(OSW_all_y, '[[',2)),
                      OSW_region_all_y$Pred)
  Density_all[Density_all$year == Term.year,]
  Density_all$scen = "All data"
  
  ################################################################################################
  #### Look at the different proposed scenarios                                               ####
  ################################################################################################
  ### Create lists for the different data frames ####
  Index_OSW = list(NA)
  Density_OSW = list(NA)
  Scen_mod = list(NA)
  
  ### For loop to go through the different scenarios - may be a better option to think through ####
  
  for(i in 1:nrow(scen)){
    print(paste0("Starting model and prediction for scenario this is missing ", scen[i,]$Scenario," of data"))
    ##############################
    ## Data set up 
    ##############################
    # Start by removing data inside the areas of interest for the different scenario years 
    if(scen[i,]$Year %in% Start.year){
      pt2a = data.frame(st_intersection(st_as_sf(data.frame(model_data), coords = c("lon", "lat"),
                                                 crs = "+proj=utm +zone=10 +datum=WGS84 +units=km"), 
                                        OSW_shp))
      pt.mod = model_data[!model_data$trawl_id %in% pt2a$trawl_id,]
    }else{#If you are only removing the data for a certain number of years 
      pt1 = model_data[model_data$year %in%  c(Start.year:scen[i,]$Year),]#Years that still sample the areas of interest 
      pt2 = model_data[!model_data$year %in% c(Start.year:scen[i,]$Year),]#Years to remove samples inside the OSW 
      pt2a = data.frame(st_intersection(st_as_sf(data.frame(pt2), coords = c("lon", "lat"),
                                                 crs = "+proj=utm +zone=10 +datum=WGS84 +units=km"), 
                                        OSW_shp))
      # ggplot(coast_outline)+
      #   geom_sf()+
      #   geom_point(data = pt2[!pt2$trawl_id %in% pt2a$trawl_id,], aes(x = lon, y=lat), size = .2)+
      #   geom_sf(data = OSW_shp, fill = 'transparent', colour = 'black', lwd = .3)
      # 
      # ggplot(coast_outline)+
      #   geom_sf()+
      #   geom_point(data = model_data[model_data$year==2023,], aes(x = lon, y=lat), size = .2)+
      #   geom_sf(data = OSW_shp, fill = 'transparent', colour = 'black', lwd = .3)
      
      pt.mod = rbind(pt1, 
                     pt2[!pt2$trawl_id %in% pt2a$trawl_id,]) #Create a data frame that has removed the OSW sample areas for 
      
      # ggplot(coast_outline)+
      #   geom_sf()+
      #   geom_point(data = pt.mod[pt.mod$year==2022,], aes(x = lon, y=lat), size = .2)+
      #   geom_sf(data = OSW_shp, fill = 'transparent', colour = 'black', lwd = .3)
    }
    
    ##############################
    ## Fit model to the new data 
    ##############################
    Mod2 = tryCatch({
      sdmTMB(data = pt.mod,
             formula = formula(Mod1),
             mesh = make_mesh(pt.mod, xy_cols = c("lon", "lat"), mesh = OG_mesh$mesh),
             family = Mod1$family,
             time = Mod1$time,
             spatiotemporal = Mod1$spatiotemporal,
             spatial = Mod1$spatial#,
           #spatial = list("on","on"),
           #spatiotemporal = list("off","IID")#,
          #   spatiotemporal = "IID"
      )},
      error = function(e) NA)
    saveRDS(Mod2, paste0(WD.1, "/sdmTMB_func/Model_",pt.mod$common_name[1],"_",OSW_shp$Scenario[1],"_",scen$Scenario[i],Sys.Date(),"_NoST.rds"))
    #Residual check - have this save to a folder somewhere?
    sanity(Mod2)
    tidy(Mod2, conf.int = T)
    # Residual check ####
  pt.mod$resid = residuals(Mod2, type ='mle-mvn')
  #pt.mod$resid2 = residuals(Mod2, type ='mle-mvn', model = 2)
  #Simulate residuals for DHARMA analysis
  start = Sys.time()
  s_Mod2 <- simulate(Mod2, nsim = 1000, type = "mle-mvn")
  print(Sys.time()-start)

  sum(s_Mod2 == 0)/length(s_Mod2); nrow(pt.mod[pt.mod$cpue_kg_km2==0,])/nrow(pt.mod)#Check that it can handle the # of zeros
  r_Mod2 = dharma_residuals(s_Mod2, Mod2, return_DHARMa = T)
  pdf(file = paste0(WD.1, "/Plots/Resid/",pt.mod$common_name[1],"_DHARMa_Residuals_plots_",OSW_shp$Scenario[1],"_",scen$Scenario[i],Sys.Date(),"_NoST.pdf"))
  plot(r_Mod2)
  DHARMa::testResiduals(r_Mod2)
  DHARMa::testZeroInflation(r_Mod2)
  dev.off()
    #MCMC-based residuals - much slower to run 
    # set.seed(123)
    # samps <- sdmTMBextra::predict_mle_mcmc(Mod2, mcmc_warmup = 100, mcmc_iter = 101)#Currently including a short number of warmup and iterations - just given that it is a trial option 
    # r <- residuals(Mod2, "mle-mcmc", mcmc_samples = samps)
    # qqnorm(r)
    # abline(a = 0, b = 1)
    
    # Spatial check ####
    OSW_model=ggplot(data = pt.mod, aes(lon, lat, col = resid)) +
      scale_colour_gradient2() +
      geom_point(size=.1) +
      facet_wrap(~year) +
      coord_fixed()+
      theme_classic()+
      theme(legend.title = element_blank())
    
    ggsave(paste0(WD.1, "/Plots/Resid/",pt.mod$common_name[1],"_",OSW_shp$Scenario[1],"_",scen$Scenario[i],Sys.Date(),"_spatial_NoST.png"),
           OSW_model,
           height = 10, width = 10, units = "in")

    #     OSW_modelb=ggplot(data = pt.mod, aes(lon, lat, col = resid2)) +
    #   scale_colour_gradient2() +
    #   geom_point(size=.1) +
    #   facet_wrap(~year) +
    #   coord_fixed()+
    #   theme_classic()+
    #   theme(legend.title = element_blank())
    # 
    # ggsave(paste0(WD.1, "/Plots/Resid/",pt.mod$common_name[1],"_",OSW_shp$Scenario[1],"_",scen$Scenario[i],"_spatial_gamma.png"),
    #        OSW_modelb,
    #        height = 10, width = 10, units = "in")
    
    ##############################
    ## Predictions 
    ##############################
    #Entire region 
    Entire_region_OSW_y = Pred_sdm_function(Pred_data = prediction_data,
                                            model = Mod2,
                                            Mod_data = pt.mod)
    #OSW areas - separately
    OSW_missing_y=list(NA)
    for(j in 1:length(Proj_df_OSW)){
      Pred_data1 = Proj_df_OSW[[j]]
      #Pred_data1$group == unique(OSW_shp$group)[j]
      OSW_missing_y[[j]] = Pred_sdm_function(Pred_data = Pred_data1,
                                             model = Mod2,
                                             Mod_data = pt.mod)
    }
    # OSW areas - all together
    OSW_region_missing_y = Pred_sdm_function(Pred_data = Proj_df_OSW_all,
                                             model = Mod2,
                                             Mod_data = pt.mod)
    
    ##############################
    ## Combine predictions together  
    ##############################
    Index_OSW[[i]] = rbind(Entire_region_OSW_y$Index, #Get all the index values together across the different regions 
                           bind_rows(lapply(OSW_missing_y, '[[',1)),
                           OSW_region_missing_y$Index)
    Index_OSW[[i]]$scen = scen[i,]$Scenario
    Density_OSW_df = rbind(Entire_region_OSW_y$Pred, #Get all the density estimates across the different regions 
                           bind_rows(lapply(OSW_missing_y, '[[',2)),
                           OSW_region_missing_y$Pred)
    Density_OSW[[i]] = Density_OSW_df#[Density_OSW_df$year == Term.year,]
    Density_OSW[[i]]$scen = scen[i,]$Scenario
    
  }
  ##############################
  ## Performance metrics for index values 
  ##############################
  print("Starting performance metrics for the index values")
  SP_Index = rbind(Index_all,bind_rows(Index_OSW[1:length(Index_OSW)]))#Combine all the regions together 
  SP_Index = SP_Index %>% 
    mutate(CI = upr-lwr) #Calculate the CI for each year 
  SP_term_PM = bind_rows(lapply(split(SP_Index, SP_Index$group), function(x){ #grab the performance metrics 
    x %>%
      group_by(group, scen) %>%
      dplyr::filter(year %in% Term.year) %>%
      mutate(CI_perc = ((CI - SP_Index[SP_Index$year ==Term.year &
                                         SP_Index$scen == "All data" &
                                         SP_Index$group %in% x$group,]$CI)/
                          ((CI + SP_Index[SP_Index$year ==Term.year &
                                            SP_Index$scen == "All data" &
                                            SP_Index$group %in% x$group,]$CI)/2))*100,
             est_RMSE = sqrt(((est - SP_Index[SP_Index$year ==Term.year &
                                                SP_Index$scen == "All data" &
                                                SP_Index$group %in% x$group,]$est))^2)#,
      )
  })) %>%
    dplyr::select(group, scen, CI_perc, est_RMSE)
  
  #########################################
  ## Performance metrics for density values 
  #########################################
  #Create lists/vectors to be filled in later 
  print("Starting performance metrics for the density estimates")
  Dens_func_values = Dens_PM_func(Dens_data = rbind(Density_all,bind_rows(Density_OSW[1:length(Density_OSW)])),
                                  Proj_extent = Proj_extent,
                                  scen = scen,
                                  OSW_shp = OSW_shp)

  #######################################################################################
  return(list(Index = SP_Index,
              Ind_pm = SP_term_PM,
              Density = rbind(Density_all,bind_rows(Density_OSW[1:length(Density_OSW)])),
              Dens_PM_ER = Dens_func_values$Density_PM_ER,
              Density_PM_OSW = Dens_func_values$Density_PM_OSW,
              Density_PM_all = Dens_func_values$Density_PM_all,
              Density_Dif = Dens_func_values$Density_Dif
              # Dif_Dens = sp_Dif,
              # Dens_PM = sp_PM
  ))
}
saveRDS(PROJ_Func_NoST, paste0(WD.1, "/Functions/PROJ_Func_NoST.rds"))
                           
PROJ_Func_DG = function(scen = NA, #Data frame of the different scenarios of interest - column 1 is the scenario, column 2 is the terminal year where sampling occurred in the OSW area 
                     prediction_data = NA, #Data frame for predictions of the sdmTMB model - no years included at the moment
                     model_data = NA, #Data for the species for fitting the models (in this case the WCGBTS data)
                     OSW_shp = NA,#SF file (polygon) for the different areas of interest (ensure that there is a column identifying them - here it is called "group")
                     Start.year = NA,
                     M.edge = NA,
                     S.edge = NA,
                     Term.year = NA, #The terminal year to assess - only pull out the density for this year 
                     Proj_extent = NA, #Shapefile or data frame to trim the projection
                     c.off = NA){ #cutoff for the INLA mesh
  ################################################################################################
  #### Gather the prediction data frames - specifically separate the individual areas        ####
  ################################################################################################
  
  #The entire prediction data frame is supplied to the function, but we need to specify the data frames for each area of interest
  
  #This for loop goes through and pulls out the prediction data inside each area of interest - in this case the four OSW areas 
  Proj_df_OSW=list(NA)
  for(x in 1:length(unique(OSW_shp$group))){
    groups = unique(OSW_shp$group)
    OSW_a=OSW_shp%>%
      filter(group==groups[x])
    
    OSW_b=st_intersection(prediction_data %>% 
                            st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"),
                                     crs = st_crs("+proj=utm +zone=10 +datum=WGS84 +units=km")), OSW_a)
    OSW_b$lon = st_coordinates(OSW_b)[,1]
    OSW_b$lat = st_coordinates(OSW_b)[,2]
    
    Proj_df_OSW[[x]] = data.frame(OSW_b)
    Proj_df_OSW[[x]]$group = unique(OSW_shp$group)[x]#Make sure group is labeled correctly 
  }  
  names(Proj_df_OSW) = unique(OSW_shp$group)#Name each element of the list by the OSW area
  
  ## Now we also want to evaluate on how indices could change if there was evidence to assess and manage these stocks as a north/south west coast stock
  Proj_df_OSW$North = prediction_data %>% select(lon, lat) %>%
    st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"),
             crs = "+proj=utm +zone=10 +datum=WGS84 +units=km") %>%
    st_transform(crs = st_crs("+proj=longlat + datum=WGS84 + no_dfs")) %>% 
    st_coordinates() %>% as_tibble() %>% rename(Lon_dd = X, Lat_dd = Y) %>%
    cbind(prediction_data) %>%
    filter(Lat_dd >=40.16667) %>% #40.10 management line for the North South Division 
    mutate(group = "North")
  
  Proj_df_OSW$South = prediction_data %>% select(lon, lat) %>%
    st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"),
             crs = "+proj=utm +zone=10 +datum=WGS84 +units=km") %>%
    st_transform(crs = st_crs("+proj=longlat + datum=WGS84 + no_dfs")) %>% 
    st_coordinates() %>% as_tibble() %>% rename(Lon_dd = X, Lat_dd = Y) %>%
    cbind(prediction_data) %>%
    filter(Lat_dd <40.16667) %>% #40.10 management line for the North South Division 
    mutate(group = "South")
  ################################################################################################
  #### Fit a model with all the data across all years                                         ####
  ################################################################################################
  # sdmTMB is utilized here, for this we need to include a mesh and the model data 
  print(paste0("Starting prediction for all years and all data for ", model_data$common_name[1]))
  OG_mesh1 = fmesher::fm_mesh_2d_inla(loc = cbind(model_data$lon, model_data$lat),
                                      max.edge = c(S.edge,M.edge),offset = c(25, 50),
                                      cutoff = c.off)
  OG_mesh = make_mesh(model_data, xy_cols = c("lon", "lat"), mesh = OG_mesh1)
  plot(OG_mesh)
  # OG_mesh = make_mesh(model_data, xy_cols = c("lon", "lat"),
  #                     cutoff = c.off,
  #                     type = "cutoff")#Create the original mesh utilizing all data
  ## Fit the model - currently only including spatial for test purposes ####
  #Ideally, fit the original model first and then use it as an input into the function?
  start = Sys.time()
  Mod1 = tryCatch({ 
    sdmTMB(data = model_data,
           formula = cpue_kg_km2 ~ as.factor(year) + s(depth_m,k=3),#Currently including year and depth as variables to consider
           mesh = OG_mesh,
           time = "year",
           #spatiotemporal = "iid",
           family = delta_gamma(),#tweedie(link = "log"),#Tweedie distribution for the moment 
           spatial = list("on","on"),
           spatiotemporal = list("off","IID"),
    )}, error = function(e) NA)
  print(Sys.time()-start)
    saveRDS(Mod1, paste0(WD.1, "/sdmTMB_func/Model_",model_data$common_name[1],"_",OSW_shp$Scenario[1],Sys.Date(),"_All_Data.rds"))

  # Model check ####
  sanity(Mod1)
  print(tidy(Mod1, conf.int = T))
  # Residual check ####
  model_data$resid1 = residuals(Mod1, type ='mle-mvn', model = 1)
  model_data$resid2 = residuals(Mod1, type ='mle-mvn', model = 2)
  #Simulate residuals for DHARMA analysis
  start = Sys.time()
  s_mod1 <- simulate(Mod1, nsim = 1000, type = "mle-mvn")
  print(Sys.time()-start)

  sum(s_mod1 == 0)/length(s_mod1); nrow(model_data[model_data$cpue_kg_km2==0,])/nrow(model_data)#Check that it can handle the # of zeros
  r_mod1 = dharma_residuals(s_mod1, Mod1, return_DHARMa = T)
  pdf(file = paste0(WD.1, "/Plots/Resid/",model_data$common_name[1],Sys.Date(),"_DHARMa_Residuals_plots.pdf"))
  plot(r_mod1)
  DHARMa::testResiduals(r_mod1)
  DHARMa::testZeroInflation(r_mod1)
  dev.off()
  # qqplot1=ggplot(model_data, aes(sample = resid)) + stat_qq() + stat_qq_line()+
  #   theme_classic()+
  #   labs(title = paste0(model_data$common_name[1], ": All data"))
  # ggsave(paste0(WD.1, "/Plots/Resid/",model_data$common_name[1],"_all_data_qqplot.png"),
  #        qqplot1,
  #        height = 4, width = 4, units = "in")
  #MCMC-based residuals - much slower to run 
  # set.seed(123)
  # samps <- sdmTMBextra::predict_mle_mcmc(Mod1, mcmc_warmup = 100, mcmc_iter = 101)#Currently including a short number of warmup and iterations - just given that it is a trial option 
  # r <- residuals(Mod1, "mle-mcmc", mcmc_samples = samps)
  # qqnorm(r)
  # abline(a = 0, b = 1)
  
  # Spatial check ####
  Mod1_spatial=ggplot() +
    scale_colour_gradient2() +
    geom_point(data = model_data, aes(lon, lat, col = resid1),size=.1) +
    facet_wrap(~year) +
    coord_fixed()+
    theme_classic()+
    theme(legend.title = element_blank())
  
  ggsave(paste0(WD.1, "/Plots/Resid/",model_data$common_name[1],Sys.Date(),"_all_data_spatial_Bin.png"),
         Mod1_spatial,
         height = 10, width = 10, units = "in")
  
    Mod1_spatialb=ggplot() +
    scale_colour_gradient2() +
    geom_point(data = model_data, aes(lon, lat, col = resid2),size=.1) +
    facet_wrap(~year) +
    coord_fixed()+
    theme_classic()+
    theme(legend.title = element_blank())
  
  ggsave(paste0(WD.1, "/Plots/Resid/",model_data$common_name[1],Sys.Date(),"_all_data_spatial_Gamma.png"),
         Mod1_spatialb,
         height = 10, width = 10, units = "in")
  
  ############################
  ### Predictions         ####
  ############################
  
  #Entire region
  Entire_region_all_y = Pred_sdm_function(Pred_data = prediction_data,
                                          model = Mod1,
                                          Mod_data = model_data)
  #OSW areas - separately
  OSW_all_y=list(NA)
  for(j in 1:length(Proj_df_OSW)){
    Pred_data1 = Proj_df_OSW[[j]]
    #Pred_data1$group == unique(OSW_shp$group)[j]
    OSW_all_y[[j]] = Pred_sdm_function(Pred_data = Pred_data1,
                                       model = Mod1,
                                       Mod_data = model_data)
  }
  # OSW areas - all together
  Proj_df_OSW_all = bind_rows(Proj_df_OSW[unique(OSW_shp$group)])
  Proj_df_OSW_all$group = "OSW"
  OSW_region_all_y = Pred_sdm_function(Pred_data = Proj_df_OSW_all,
                                       model = Mod1,
                                       Mod_data = model_data)
  
  ## Combine all the data together for plotting and analysis ##
  Index_all = rbind(Entire_region_all_y$Index, #Get all the index values together across the different regions 
                    bind_rows(lapply(OSW_all_y, '[[',1)),
                    OSW_region_all_y$Index)
  Index_all$scen = "All data"
  Density_all = rbind(Entire_region_all_y$Pred, #Get all the density estimates across the different regions 
                      bind_rows(lapply(OSW_all_y, '[[',2)),
                      OSW_region_all_y$Pred)
  Density_all[Density_all$year == Term.year,]
  Density_all$scen = "All data"
  
  ################################################################################################
  #### Look at the different proposed scenarios                                               ####
  ################################################################################################
  ### Create lists for the different data frames ####
  Index_OSW = list(NA)
  Density_OSW = list(NA)
  Scen_mod = list(NA)
  
  ### For loop to go through the different scenarios - may be a better option to think through ####
  
  for(i in 1:nrow(scen)){
    print(paste0("Starting model and prediction for scenario this is missing ", scen[i,]$Scenario," of data"))
    ##############################
    ## Data set up 
    ##############################
    # Start by removing data inside the areas of interest for the different scenario years 
    if(scen[i,]$Year %in% Start.year){
      pt2a = data.frame(st_intersection(st_as_sf(data.frame(model_data), coords = c("lon", "lat"),
                                                 crs = "+proj=utm +zone=10 +datum=WGS84 +units=km"), 
                                        OSW_shp))
      pt.mod = model_data[!model_data$trawl_id %in% pt2a$trawl_id,]
    }else{#If you are only removing the data for a certain number of years 
      pt1 = model_data[model_data$year %in%  c(Start.year:scen[i,]$Year),]#Years that still sample the areas of interest 
      pt2 = model_data[!model_data$year %in% c(Start.year:scen[i,]$Year),]#Years to remove samples inside the OSW 
      pt2a = data.frame(st_intersection(st_as_sf(data.frame(pt2), coords = c("lon", "lat"),
                                                 crs = "+proj=utm +zone=10 +datum=WGS84 +units=km"), 
                                        OSW_shp))
      # ggplot(coast_outline)+
      #   geom_sf()+
      #   geom_point(data = pt2[!pt2$trawl_id %in% pt2a$trawl_id,], aes(x = lon, y=lat), size = .2)+
      #   geom_sf(data = OSW_shp, fill = 'transparent', colour = 'black', lwd = .3)
      # 
      # ggplot(coast_outline)+
      #   geom_sf()+
      #   geom_point(data = model_data[model_data$year==2023,], aes(x = lon, y=lat), size = .2)+
      #   geom_sf(data = OSW_shp, fill = 'transparent', colour = 'black', lwd = .3)
      
      pt.mod = rbind(pt1, 
                     pt2[!pt2$trawl_id %in% pt2a$trawl_id,]) #Create a data frame that has removed the OSW sample areas for 
      
      # ggplot(coast_outline)+
      #   geom_sf()+
      #   geom_point(data = pt.mod[pt.mod$year==2022,], aes(x = lon, y=lat), size = .2)+
      #   geom_sf(data = OSW_shp, fill = 'transparent', colour = 'black', lwd = .3)
    }
    
    ##############################
    ## Fit model to the new data 
    ##############################
    Mod2 = tryCatch({
      sdmTMB(data = pt.mod,
             formula = formula(Mod1),
             mesh = make_mesh(pt.mod, xy_cols = c("lon", "lat"), mesh = OG_mesh$mesh),
             family = Mod1$family,
             time = Mod1$time,
             #spatiotemporal = Mod1$spatiotemporal,
           #  spatial = Mod1$spatial,
           spatial = list("on","on"),
           spatiotemporal = list("off","IID")#,
          #   spatiotemporal = "IID"
      )},
      error = function(e) NA)
      saveRDS(Mod2, paste0(WD.1, "/sdmTMB_func/Model_",pt.mod$common_name[1],"_",OSW_shp$Scenario[1],"_",scen$Scenario[i],Sys.Date(),".rds"))

    #Residual check - have this save to a folder somewhere?
    sanity(Mod2)
    tidy(Mod2, conf.int = T)
    # Residual check ####
  pt.mod$resid1 = residuals(Mod2, type ='mle-mvn', model = 1)
  pt.mod$resid2 = residuals(Mod2, type ='mle-mvn', model = 2)
  #Simulate residuals for DHARMA analysis
  start = Sys.time()
  s_Mod2 <- simulate(Mod2, nsim = 1000, type = "mle-mvn")
  print(Sys.time()-start)

  sum(s_Mod2 == 0)/length(s_Mod2); nrow(pt.mod[pt.mod$cpue_kg_km2==0,])/nrow(pt.mod)#Check that it can handle the # of zeros
  r_Mod2 = dharma_residuals(s_Mod2, Mod2, return_DHARMa = T)
  pdf(file = paste0(WD.1, "/Plots/Resid/",pt.mod$common_name[1],"_DHARMa_Residuals_plots_",OSW_shp$Scenario[1],"_",scen$Scenario[i],Sys.Date(),".pdf"))
  plot(r_Mod2)
  DHARMa::testResiduals(r_Mod2)
  DHARMa::testZeroInflation(r_Mod2)
  dev.off()
    #MCMC-based residuals - much slower to run 
    # set.seed(123)
    # samps <- sdmTMBextra::predict_mle_mcmc(Mod2, mcmc_warmup = 100, mcmc_iter = 101)#Currently including a short number of warmup and iterations - just given that it is a trial option 
    # r <- residuals(Mod2, "mle-mcmc", mcmc_samples = samps)
    # qqnorm(r)
    # abline(a = 0, b = 1)
    
    # Spatial check ####
    OSW_model=ggplot(data = pt.mod, aes(lon, lat, col = resid1)) +
      scale_colour_gradient2() +
      geom_point(size=.1) +
      facet_wrap(~year) +
      coord_fixed()+
      theme_classic()+
      theme(legend.title = element_blank())
    
    ggsave(paste0(WD.1, "/Plots/Resid/",pt.mod$common_name[1],"_",OSW_shp$Scenario[1],"_",scen$Scenario[i],Sys.Date(),"_spatial_bin.png"),
           OSW_model,
           height = 10, width = 10, units = "in")

        OSW_modelb=ggplot(data = pt.mod, aes(lon, lat, col = resid2)) +
      scale_colour_gradient2() +
      geom_point(size=.1) +
      facet_wrap(~year) +
      coord_fixed()+
      theme_classic()+
      theme(legend.title = element_blank())
    
    ggsave(paste0(WD.1, "/Plots/Resid/",pt.mod$common_name[1],"_",OSW_shp$Scenario[1],"_",scen$Scenario[i],Sys.Date(),"_spatial_gamma.png"),
           OSW_modelb,
           height = 10, width = 10, units = "in")
    
    ##############################
    ## Predictions 
    ##############################
    #Entire region 
    Entire_region_OSW_y = Pred_sdm_function(Pred_data = prediction_data,
                                            model = Mod2,
                                            Mod_data = pt.mod)
    #OSW areas - separately
    OSW_missing_y=list(NA)
    for(j in 1:length(Proj_df_OSW)){
      Pred_data1 = Proj_df_OSW[[j]]
      #Pred_data1$group == unique(OSW_shp$group)[j]
      OSW_missing_y[[j]] = Pred_sdm_function(Pred_data = Pred_data1,
                                             model = Mod2,
                                             Mod_data = pt.mod)
    }
    # OSW areas - all together
    OSW_region_missing_y = Pred_sdm_function(Pred_data = Proj_df_OSW_all,
                                             model = Mod2,
                                             Mod_data = pt.mod)
    
    ##############################
    ## Combine predictions together  
    ##############################
    Index_OSW[[i]] = rbind(Entire_region_OSW_y$Index, #Get all the index values together across the different regions 
                           bind_rows(lapply(OSW_missing_y, '[[',1)),
                           OSW_region_missing_y$Index)
    Index_OSW[[i]]$scen = scen[i,]$Scenario
    Density_OSW_df = rbind(Entire_region_OSW_y$Pred, #Get all the density estimates across the different regions 
                           bind_rows(lapply(OSW_missing_y, '[[',2)),
                           OSW_region_missing_y$Pred)
    Density_OSW[[i]] = Density_OSW_df#[Density_OSW_df$year == Term.year,]
    Density_OSW[[i]]$scen = scen[i,]$Scenario
    
  }
  ##############################
  ## Performance metrics for index values 
  ##############################
  print("Starting performance metrics for the index values")
  SP_Index = rbind(Index_all,bind_rows(Index_OSW[1:length(Index_OSW)]))#Combine all the regions together 
  SP_Index = SP_Index %>% 
    mutate(CI = upr-lwr) #Calculate the CI for each year 
  SP_term_PM = bind_rows(lapply(split(SP_Index, SP_Index$group), function(x){ #grab the performance metrics 
    x %>%
      group_by(group, scen) %>%
      dplyr::filter(year %in% Term.year) %>%
      mutate(CI_perc = ((CI - SP_Index[SP_Index$year ==Term.year &
                                         SP_Index$scen == "All data" &
                                         SP_Index$group %in% x$group,]$CI)/
                          ((CI + SP_Index[SP_Index$year ==Term.year &
                                            SP_Index$scen == "All data" &
                                            SP_Index$group %in% x$group,]$CI)/2))*100,
             est_RMSE = sqrt(((est - SP_Index[SP_Index$year ==Term.year &
                                                SP_Index$scen == "All data" &
                                                SP_Index$group %in% x$group,]$est))^2)#,
      )
  })) %>%
    dplyr::select(group, scen, CI_perc, est_RMSE)
  
  #########################################
  ## Performance metrics for density values 
  #########################################
  #Create lists/vectors to be filled in later 
  print("Starting performance metrics for the density estimates")
  Dens_func_values = Dens_PM_func_DG(Dens_data = rbind(Density_all,bind_rows(Density_OSW[1:length(Density_OSW)])),
                                  Proj_extent = Proj_extent,
                                  scen = scen,
                                  OSW_shp = OSW_shp)

  #######################################################################################
  return(list(Index = SP_Index,
              Ind_pm = SP_term_PM,
              Density = rbind(Density_all,bind_rows(Density_OSW[1:length(Density_OSW)])),
              Dens_PM_ER = Dens_func_values$Density_PM_ER,
              Density_PM_OSW = Dens_func_values$Density_PM_OSW,
              Density_PM_all = Dens_func_values$Density_PM_all,
              Density_Dif = Dens_func_values$Density_Dif
              # Dif_Dens = sp_Dif,
              # Dens_PM = sp_PM
  ))
}

saveRDS(PROJ_Func_DG, paste0(WD.1, "/Functions/PROJ_Func_DG.rds"))


PROJ_Func_DG_NoST = function(scen = NA, #Data frame of the different scenarios of interest - column 1 is the scenario, column 2 is the terminal year where sampling occurred in the OSW area 
                     prediction_data = NA, #Data frame for predictions of the sdmTMB model - no years included at the moment
                     model_data = NA, #Data for the species for fitting the models (in this case the WCGBTS data)
                     OSW_shp = NA,#SF file (polygon) for the different areas of interest (ensure that there is a column identifying them - here it is called "group")
                     Start.year = NA,
                     M.edge = NA,
                     S.edge = NA,
                     Term.year = NA, #The terminal year to assess - only pull out the density for this year 
                     Proj_extent = NA, #Shapefile or data frame to trim the projection
                     c.off = NA){ #cutoff for the INLA mesh
  ################################################################################################
  #### Gather the prediction data frames - specifically separate the individual areas        ####
  ################################################################################################
  
  #The entire prediction data frame is supplied to the function, but we need to specify the data frames for each area of interest
  
  #This for loop goes through and pulls out the prediction data inside each area of interest - in this case the four OSW areas 
  Proj_df_OSW=list(NA)
  for(x in 1:length(unique(OSW_shp$group))){
    groups = unique(OSW_shp$group)
    OSW_a=OSW_shp%>%
      filter(group==groups[x])
    
    OSW_b=st_intersection(prediction_data %>% 
                            st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"),
                                     crs = st_crs("+proj=utm +zone=10 +datum=WGS84 +units=km")), OSW_a)
    OSW_b$lon = st_coordinates(OSW_b)[,1]
    OSW_b$lat = st_coordinates(OSW_b)[,2]
    
    Proj_df_OSW[[x]] = data.frame(OSW_b)
    Proj_df_OSW[[x]]$group = unique(OSW_shp$group)[x]#Make sure group is labeled correctly 
  }  
  names(Proj_df_OSW) = unique(OSW_shp$group)#Name each element of the list by the OSW area
  
  ## Now we also want to evaluate on how indices could change if there was evidence to assess and manage these stocks as a north/south west coast stock
  Proj_df_OSW$North = prediction_data %>% select(lon, lat) %>%
    st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"),
             crs = "+proj=utm +zone=10 +datum=WGS84 +units=km") %>%
    st_transform(crs = st_crs("+proj=longlat + datum=WGS84 + no_dfs")) %>% 
    st_coordinates() %>% as_tibble() %>% rename(Lon_dd = X, Lat_dd = Y) %>%
    cbind(prediction_data) %>%
    filter(Lat_dd >=40.16667) %>% #40.10 management line for the North South Division 
    mutate(group = "North")
  
  Proj_df_OSW$South = prediction_data %>% select(lon, lat) %>%
    st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"),
             crs = "+proj=utm +zone=10 +datum=WGS84 +units=km") %>%
    st_transform(crs = st_crs("+proj=longlat + datum=WGS84 + no_dfs")) %>% 
    st_coordinates() %>% as_tibble() %>% rename(Lon_dd = X, Lat_dd = Y) %>%
    cbind(prediction_data) %>%
    filter(Lat_dd <40.16667) %>% #40.10 management line for the North South Division 
    mutate(group = "South")
  ################################################################################################
  #### Fit a model with all the data across all years                                         ####
  ################################################################################################
  # sdmTMB is utilized here, for this we need to include a mesh and the model data 
  print(paste0("Starting prediction for all years and all data for ", model_data$common_name[1]))
  OG_mesh1 = fmesher::fm_mesh_2d_inla(loc = cbind(model_data$lon, model_data$lat),
                                      max.edge = c(S.edge,M.edge),offset = c(25, 50),
                                      cutoff = c.off)
  OG_mesh = make_mesh(model_data, xy_cols = c("lon", "lat"), mesh = OG_mesh1)
  plot(OG_mesh)
  # OG_mesh = make_mesh(model_data, xy_cols = c("lon", "lat"),
  #                     cutoff = c.off,
  #                     type = "cutoff")#Create the original mesh utilizing all data
  ## Fit the model - currently only including spatial for test purposes ####
  #Ideally, fit the original model first and then use it as an input into the function?
  start = Sys.time()
  Mod1 = tryCatch({ 
    sdmTMB(data = model_data,
           formula = cpue_kg_km2 ~ as.factor(year) + s(depth_m,k=3),#Currently including year and depth as variables to consider
           mesh = OG_mesh,
           time = "year",
           #spatiotemporal = "iid",
           family = delta_gamma(),#tweedie(link = "log"),#Tweedie distribution for the moment 
           spatial = list("on","on"),
           spatiotemporal = list("off","off"),
    )}, error = function(e) NA)
  print(Sys.time()-start)
    saveRDS(Mod1, paste0(WD.1, "/sdmTMB_func/Model_",model_data$common_name[1],"_",OSW_shp$Scenario[1],Sys.Date(),"_All_Data_NoST.rds"))

  # Model check ####
  sanity(Mod1)
  print(tidy(Mod1, conf.int = T))
  # Residual check ####
  model_data$resid1 = residuals(Mod1, type ='mle-mvn', model = 1)
  model_data$resid2 = residuals(Mod1, type ='mle-mvn', model = 2)
  #Simulate residuals for DHARMA analysis
  start = Sys.time()
  s_mod1 <- simulate(Mod1, nsim = 1000, type = "mle-mvn")
  print(Sys.time()-start)

  sum(s_mod1 == 0)/length(s_mod1); nrow(model_data[model_data$cpue_kg_km2==0,])/nrow(model_data)#Check that it can handle the # of zeros
  r_mod1 = dharma_residuals(s_mod1, Mod1, return_DHARMa = T)
  pdf(file = paste0(WD.1, "/Plots/Resid/",model_data$common_name[1],Sys.Date(),"_DHARMa_Residuals_plots_NoST.pdf"))
  plot(r_mod1)
  DHARMa::testResiduals(r_mod1)
  DHARMa::testZeroInflation(r_mod1)
  dev.off()
  # qqplot1=ggplot(model_data, aes(sample = resid)) + stat_qq() + stat_qq_line()+

  #        qqplot1,

  #MCMC-based residuals - much slower to run

  # r <- residuals(Mod1, "mle-mcmc", mcmc_samples = samps)
  # qqnorm(r)

  # Spatial check ####
  Mod1_spatial=ggplot() +

  ggsave(paste0(WD.1, "/Plots/Resid/",model_data$common_name[1],Sys.Date(),"_all_data_spatial_Bin_NoST.png"),
         Mod1_spatial,
         height = 10, width = 10, units = "in")
  
    Mod1_spatialb=ggplot() +

  ggsave(paste0(WD.1, "/Plots/Resid/",model_data$common_name[1],Sys.Date(),"_all_data_spatial_Gamma_NoST.png"),
         Mod1_spatialb,
         height = 10, width = 10, units = "in")
  
  ############################
  ### Predictions         ####
  ############################
  
  #Entire region
  Entire_region_all_y = Pred_sdm_function(Pred_data = prediction_data,
                                          model = Mod1,
                                          Mod_data = model_data)
  #OSW areas - separately
  OSW_all_y=list(NA)
  for(j in 1:length(Proj_df_OSW)){

  Density_all[Density_all$year == Term.year,]

  ################################################################################################

      pt.mod = rbind(pt1, 
                     pt2[!pt2$trawl_id %in% pt2a$trawl_id,]) #Create a data frame that has removed the OSW sample areas for

    ##############################

    #Residual check - have this save to a folder somewhere?

    # Residual check ####
  pt.mod$resid1 = residuals(Mod2, type ='mle-mvn', model = 1)

  r_Mod2 = dharma_residuals(s_Mod2, Mod2, return_DHARMa = T)
  pdf(file = paste0(WD.1, "/Plots/Resid/",pt.mod$common_name[1],"_DHARMa_Residuals_plots_",OSW_shp$Scenario[1],"_",scen$Scenario[i],Sys.Date(),"_NoST.pdf"))
  plot(r_Mod2)

  dev.off()
    #MCMC-based residuals - much slower to run

    # Spatial check ####
    OSW_model=ggplot(data = pt.mod, aes(lon, lat, col = resid1)) +

           OSW_model,

        OSW_modelb=ggplot(data = pt.mod, aes(lon, lat, col = resid2)) +

    ##############################

  }
  ##############################

             est_RMSE = sqrt(((est - SP_Index[SP_Index$year ==Term.year &

  #########################################

  ))
```
