## Plotting functions 

The first function is a function that collects and scales the index values from the projection function to the mean of the "All Data" scenario across multiple spatial scales. Function returns both the scaled index values and plots. 

```{r plotting fucntions index scaling }

Ind_func = function(dt1 = NA,#Index data from the sdm function
                    Spec_title = NA,
                    lev_scen = NA,#Levels for the different scenarios
                    lev_osw = NA){#Levels for the different OSW areas 
  dt_num = dt1 %>%
    filter(scen == "All data", !is.na(est)) %>%
    group_by(group) %>%
    summarise(mean = mean(est))
  
  Scaled_ind=merge(dt_num,  dt1 %>%
    group_by(group, scen), by = "group" ) %>%
    reframe(group = .[[1]], 
            scen = scen,
            year = year,
            est_s = est/mean,
              upr_s = upr/mean,
              lwr_s = lwr/mean)

    Scaled_ind$scen = factor(Scaled_ind$scen,
                      levels = lev_scen)#Assign the levels 
    Scaled_ind$group = factor(Scaled_ind$group,
                       levels = lev_osw)#Assign the levels 
    Scaled_plot = ggplot(Scaled_ind, aes(as.numeric(as.character(year)), est_s, colour = scen, fill = scen, lty = scen)) +
      geom_hline(yintercept = 1, lwd=.4, lty = 2)+
      geom_line(lwd = .4) +
      geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = lwr_s, ymax = upr_s), alpha = 0.1, colour = NA) +
      xlab('Year') + ylab('Mean scaled biomass estimate (kg)')+
      labs(title = paste0(Spec_title)) + 
      scale_colour_viridis_d(name = "Scenario")+
      scale_fill_viridis_d(name = "Scenario")+
      scale_linetype(name = "Scenario")+
      facet_wrap(~group)+
      theme_classic() +
      scale_x_continuous(expand = c(0,0))+
      scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0), 
                         limits = c(0,max(round(Scaled_ind$upr_s,0))))+
      theme(legend.location = "bottom")

  # ggsave(paste0(WD.1, "/Plots/Index/",Spec_title,"_scaled_index.png"), Scaled_plot, 
  #        height = 4, width = 6, units = "in")
  return(list(Scaled_data = Scaled_ind,
              Scaled_plot = Scaled_plot))
}

saveRDS(Ind_func, paste0(WD.1, "/Functions/Ind_func.rds"))#Index function 

```

```{r plotting fucntions Index performance metrics  }

Ind_PM_func = function(dt1 = NA, 
                       lev_scen = NA,
                       lev_osw = NA, 
                       Spec_title = NA,
                       scen = NA){
  #Set up the data - calculate CV and SD for the index 
  n_dens=dt1  %>%
    group_by(group) %>%
    count()
  n_dens$n = n_dens$n/length(unique(dt1$year))#Get the number of grid cells for each index 
  
  dt1 = merge(dt1, n_dens, by = "group")
  dt1 = dt1 %>%
    mutate(SD_nolog = ((upr-est)/1.96)#/sqrt(n) - ASSUMES 95% CI
         )
  dt1$CV = dt1$SD_nolog/dt1$est #Calculate CV
  
  #Organize data to calculate differences in CV and performance metrics for est
  group_est = list(NA)
  for(i in 1:length(unique(scen$Scenario))){
          ### Part 1 - set up the data frame ####
          #Create dataframe of density where things are properly labeled and estimate is Exp
    df1 = dt1 %>%
      dplyr::select(year, est, group, scen, CV) %>%
      rename(Scenario = scen) 
      #Create two data frames for the two different scenarios of concern 
    df_scen = df1 %>%
      filter(Scenario == unique(scen$Scenario)[i]) %>%
      select(year, est, CV, group)
    colnames(df_scen) = c("year", paste0(unique(scen$Scenario)[i],"_est"),
                          paste0(unique(scen$Scenario)[i],"_CV"),"group")
    df_all_data = df1 %>%
      filter(Scenario == "All data") %>%
      select(year, est, CV ,group) %>%
      rename("All data_est" = est,
             "All data_cv" = CV)   
      #Merge the two dataframes together 
    DF_dif = merge(df_all_data, df_scen, by = c("year", "group"))
    group_est[[i]] = DF_dif %>% 
      mutate(Dif_est = .[[5]]-.[[3]],
             Dif_CV = .[[6]]-.[[4]],
             scen = unique(scen$Scenario)[i]) 
    colnames(group_est[[i]]) = c("year", "group","All data_est","All data_cv",
                                 "Est","CV","Dif_est","Dif_cv", "scen")
  }
  pm_ind = bind_rows(group_est)  
  
  #Performance metric - CV 

   pm_ind$scen = factor(pm_ind$scen, levels = lev_scen)
   pm_ind$group = factor(pm_ind$group, levels = lev_osw)
   pm_ind$Spec = Spec_title
   CV_year_plot = ggplot(pm_ind, aes(x = year, y = Dif_cv, colour = scen, lty = scen))+
     geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey", lty = 2)+
     geom_point(size = .4)+
     geom_line()+
     scale_colour_viridis_d(name = "Scenario")+
     scale_linetype(name = "Scenario")+
     facet_nested(Spec~group) + 
     labs(x = " ", y = "Difference in year CV estimates")+
     scale_y_continuous(expand=c(0,0)) + 
     theme_classic()+
     theme(legend.position = "bottom",
           strip.placement = "outside")
   
   ggsave(paste0(WD.1, "/Plots/Index_pm/",Spec_title,"_year_CV.png"), CV_year_plot, 
         height = 4, width = 10, units = "in")
   
   pm_CV = pm_ind %>%
     group_by(group, scen) %>%
     summarize(mean_dif = mean(na.omit(Dif_cv)))
  
    pm_CV$Spec = Spec_title

   CV_mean_plot = ggplot(pm_CV, aes(x = scen, y = mean_dif))+
     geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(0.9))+
     #labs(title = paste0(Spec_title)) + 
     facet_nested(Spec~group) + 
     theme_classic()+
     theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 5))+
     geom_hline(yintercept = 0) + 
     scale_fill_discrete(name = " ")+
     labs(x = "Scenarios", y = "Average difference in CVs")+
     scale_y_continuous(expand=c(0,0), limits = c(0,max(pm_CV$mean_dif)+.01))+
     scale_x_discrete(guide = guide_axis(n.dodge = 2))+
     theme(strip.placement = "outside")
   
      ggsave(paste0(WD.1, "/Plots/Index_pm/",Spec_title,"_year_mean.png"), CV_mean_plot, 
         height = 3, width = 12, units = "in")

   ## Performance metric - Index point estimate 
   pm_ind2 = pm_ind[complete.cases(pm_ind),] %>%
     group_by(group, scen) %>%
     summarise(RMSE = sqrt((sum((Dif_est)^2))/length(unique(pm_ind$year))),
               MAE = abs(sum(Dif_est))/length(unique(pm_ind$year))) 
   
   pm_ind2$scen = factor(pm_ind2$scen, levels = lev_scen)
   pm_ind2$group = factor(pm_ind2$group, levels = lev_osw)
   
   pm_ind3=pm_ind2 %>%
     pivot_longer(c(RMSE, MAE), names_to = "Error", values_to = "Val")
   
   pm_ind3$Spec = Spec_title

   Ind_PM_plot  = ggplot(pm_ind3, aes(x = scen, y = Val, fill = Error))+
     geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(0.9))+
     facet_nested(Spec~group) + 
     theme_classic()+
     theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 5))+
     geom_hline(yintercept = 0) + 
     scale_fill_discrete(name = " ")+
     labs(x = "Scenarios", y = "Performance metrics for biomass estimates")+
     scale_y_continuous(expand=c(0,0))+
     scale_x_discrete(guide = guide_axis(n.dodge = 2))+
     theme(strip.placement = "outside")
   
   ggsave(paste0(WD.1, "/Plots/Index_pm/",Spec_title,"_ind_PM.png"), Ind_PM_plot, 
          height = 3, width = 12, units = "in")

   return(list(PM_ind = pm_ind,
          CV_mean_plot = CV_mean_plot,
          CV_year_plot = CV_year_plot,
          Ind_PM_plot = Ind_PM_plot))
}
```

```{r plotting fucntions Density Performance Metrics across entire region  }
Den_pm_ER_plot_Func = function(Den_data_ER = NA,

            # strip.background.y = element_blank(),
            # strip.text.y = element_blank(),
            plot.margin = unit(c(.1,0,.1,0), "cm")
            )

    gr_plot_OSW_RMSE = ggplot()+
              geom_sf(data=Coast)+
      geom_tile(data = Den_data_ER, 
                aes(x=X, y=Y,fill = RMSE), size = .1)+
      facet_nested(~scen)+
scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#2166ac",
                                    mid = "#f7f7f7",
                                    high = "#b2182b",
                                    midpoint = quantile(Den_data_ER$RMSE, 0.5),
                                    limits = c(0, quantile(Den_data_ER$RMSE, 0.999)),
                           na.value = "#b2182b"
                           )+
      theme_classic()+
      xlim(min(Den_data_ER$X),
           max(Den_data_ER$X))+
      ylim(min(Den_data_ER$Y),
           max(Den_data_ER$Y))+
      geom_sf(data = OSW_shp, fill = 'transparent', colour = 'black', lwd = .05)+
      theme(axis.text = element_blank(),
            axis.title = element_blank(),
            axis.line = element_blank(),
            axis.ticks = element_blank(), 
            legend.key.width = unit(2, "cm"),
            legend.position = "bottom",
            # strip.background.y = element_blank(),
            # strip.text.y = element_blank(),
            plot.margin = unit(c(.1,0,.1,0), "cm")
            )

    ggsave(paste0(WD.1, "/Plots/Density/Entire region/",Species,"_RMSE_", Sys.Date(),".png"),gr_plot_OSW_RMSE, 
         height = 4, width = 6, units = "in")
    
    ggsave(paste0(WD.1, "/Plots/Density/Entire region/",Species,"_MAE_",Sys.Date(),".png"),gr_plot_OSW_MAE, 
         height = 4, width = 6, units = "in")
    
    return(list(RMSE_plot = gr_plot_OSW_RMSE,
                MAE_plot = gr_plot_OSW_MAE))

}
```

```{r plotting function density plotting function}
Dens_plot_func = function(Dens_data = NA,
                         #Dens_dif = NA,
                        scen = NA,
                        Proj_extent = NA,
                        OSW_shp = NA,
                        Coast = NA,
                        lev_scen = NA, 
                        Term.year = NA){
  # List to be filled 
    SP_dens = Dens_data
    SP_dens_ER = Dens_data %>%
      filter(group %in% "Entire region")
    
    group_dif_ER = list()
    gr_group_xy <- list()
    gr_group = list()
    gr_pred_group = list()
    group_dif = list()
    group_list = list()
    
    #Grab points for plotting - entire region 
    gr=st_bbox(SP_dens[SP_dens$scen=="All data",] %>%
                 st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"),
                          crs = st_crs("+proj=utm +zone=10 +datum=WGS84 +units=km"))) %>%
      st_make_grid(cellsize=.5, what='centers')%>%
      st_as_sf() %>%
      st_intersection(st_as_sfc((Proj_extent)))
    gr_xy <- st_coordinates(gr)

    #Grab points for plotting - OSW areas 
    for(i in 1:length(unique(OSW_shp$group))){ 
    #Create a data frame for each OSW area
      gr_group[[i]]= gr %>%
        st_intersection(st_as_sfc(OSW_shp[OSW_shp$group==unique(OSW_shp$group)[i],]))
      gr_group_xy[[i]] = st_coordinates(gr_group[[i]])
    }
    names(gr_group) = unique(OSW_shp$group)
    names(gr_group_xy) = unique(OSW_shp$group)

    
    #Now calculate the density performance metrics 
    sp_PM = SP_dens_ER %>%
      filter(year == Term.year) %>%
      select(lon, lat, group, year, est, scen) %>%
      mutate(est2 = exp(est)) %>%
      rename(X = lon,
             Y = lat)

    gr_pred_dif = bind_rows(lapply(split(sp_PM, sp_PM$scen), function(x){
      pred_points <- x %>%
      dplyr::select(X,Y) %>% as.matrix()
      nns <- nn2(pred_points,gr_xy,k=1)$nn.idx
      gr_pred <- gr_xy %>% as_tibble() %>% mutate(Est=x$est2[nns])
      gr_pred$scen = x$scen[1]
      return(gr_pred)
      }))

    gr_pred_dif_OSW = bind_rows(lapply(split(sp_PM, sp_PM$scen), function(x){
      scen_list = list()
      for(i in 1:length(gr_group_xy)){
        pred_points <- x %>%
          dplyr::select(X,Y) %>% as.matrix()
        nns <- nn2(pred_points,gr_group_xy[[i]],k=1)$nn.idx
        gr_pred <- gr_group_xy[[i]] %>% as_tibble() %>% mutate(Est=x$est2[nns])
        gr_pred$scen = x$scen[1]
        gr_pred$OSW = names(gr_group_xy)[i]
        scen_list[[i]] = gr_pred
        }
      return(bind_rows(scen_list))
      }))
    ## Plots 
    
        gr_pred_dif$scen = factor(gr_pred_dif$scen,
                           levels = lev_scen)#Assign the levels 

        gr_pred_dif_OSW$scen = factor(gr_pred_dif_OSW$scen,
                           levels = lev_scen)#Assign the levels 

    
    # Entire range 
        Den_ER_plot = ggplot(Coast)+
          geom_sf()+
          geom_tile(data = gr_pred_dif, aes(x=X, y=Y, ,fill = Est))+
          facet_wrap(~scen, nrow = 1)+
          scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#f7fcfd",
                               mid = "#ccece6",
                               high = "#00441b",
                               na.value = "#00441b", 
                               midpoint = quantile(gr_pred_dif$Est, 0.25),
                               limits = c(0, quantile(gr_pred_dif$Est, 0.99)))+
          # scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#0571b0",
          #                      mid = "#f7f7f7",
          #                      high = "#ca0020",
          #                      limits = c(min(gr_pred_dif$Dif),
          #                                 max(gr_pred_dif$Dif))) +
          labs(x = "", y="") + 
          theme_classic()+
          xlim(min(gr_pred_dif$X),
               max(gr_pred_dif$X))+
          ylim(min(gr_pred_dif$Y),
               max(gr_pred_dif$Y))+
          geom_sf(data = OSW_shp, fill = 'transparent', colour = 'black', lwd = .05)+
          theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 5))

        ## Different areas 
          range_x = list()
          for(i in 1:length(unique(gr_pred_dif_OSW$OSW))){
            range_x[[i]] = abs(gr_pred_dif_OSW %>%
                              filter(OSW == unique(OSW_shp$group)[i]) %>%
                              select(X) %>%
                              summarise(min = min(X)) -
                              gr_pred_dif_OSW %>%
                              filter(OSW == unique(OSW_shp$group)[i]) %>%
                              select(X) %>%
                              summarise(max = max(X))) 
    }
  Max_range=max(unlist(range_x))
  
  range_y = list()
          for(i in 1:length(unique(gr_pred_dif_OSW$OSW))){
            range_y[[i]] = abs(gr_pred_dif_OSW %>%
                              filter(OSW == unique(OSW_shp$group)[i]) %>%
                              select(Y) %>%
                              summarise(max = max(Y)) -
                              gr_pred_dif_OSW %>%
                              filter(OSW == unique(OSW_shp$group)[i]) %>%
                              select(Y) %>%
                              summarise(min = min(Y))) 
    }
  Max_range_y=max(unlist(range_y))
        
        # Dif_plots = list()
        # 
        # for(i in 1:length(unique(gr_pred_dif_OSW$OSW))){
        #   w = gr_pred_dif_OSW[gr_pred_dif_OSW$OSW %in% unique(gr_pred_dif_OSW$OSW)[i],]
        #   Dif_plots[[i]] = ggplot()+
        #     geom_tile(data = w, aes(x=X, y=Y, ,fill = Dif))+
        #     facet_nested(OSW~scen)+
        #     scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#0571b0",
        #                          mid = "#f7f7f7",
        #                          high = "#ca0020",
        #                          limits = c(min(gr_pred_dif$Dif),
        #                                     max(gr_pred_dif$Dif))) +
        #     theme_classic()+
        #     labs(x = "", y="") +
        #     xlim(mean(w$X) - Max_range/2,
        #          mean(w$X) + Max_range/2)+
        #     ylim(ifelse((median(w$Y) - Max_range_y/1.95)<min(w$Y), 
        #                 (median(w$Y) - Max_range_y/1.95),
        #                 min(w$Y)),
        #          median(w$Y) + Max_range_y/1.95)+
        #     geom_sf(data = OSW_shp, fill = 'transparent', colour = 'black', lwd = .75)+
        #     theme(axis.text = element_blank(),
        #           axis.line = element_blank(),
        #           axis.ticks = element_blank(),
        #           axis.title = element_blank())
        #   }
    
    return(list(Density_dif_ER = gr_pred_dif,
                Density_dif_OSW = gr_pred_dif_OSW,
                Dif_plot_ER = Den_ER_plot#,
                #Dif_plot_OSW = Dif_plots
                ))
}

saveRDS(Dens_plot_func, paste0(WD.1, "/Functions/Dens_plot_func.rds"))#Index function
```

```{r Plotting function density directional function }
Dens_Prc_Change_func.b = function(Dens_data = NA,
                         Dens_dif = NA,
                         #scen = NA,
                         Proj_extent = NA,
                         OSW_shp = NA,
                         Coast = NA,
                         lev_scen = NA, 
                         Term.year = NA){
  # List to be filled 
  SP_dens = Dens_data
  SP_dens_ER = Dens_data %>%
    filter(group %in% "Entire region")
  
  group_dif_ER = list()
  gr_group_xy <- list()
  gr_group = list()
  gr_pred_group = list()
  group_dif = list()
  group_list = list()
  
  #Grab points for plotting - entire region 
  gr=st_bbox(SP_dens[SP_dens$scen=="All data",] %>%
               st_as_sf(coords = c("lon", "lat"),
                        crs = st_crs("+proj=utm +zone=10 +datum=WGS84 +units=km"))) %>%
    st_make_grid(cellsize=.5, what='centers')%>%
    st_as_sf() %>%
    st_intersection(st_as_sfc((Proj_extent)))
  gr_xy <- st_coordinates(gr)
  
  #Grab points for plotting - OSW areas 
  for(i in 1:length(unique(OSW_shp$group))){ 
    #Create a data frame for each OSW area
    gr_group[[i]]= gr %>%
      st_intersection(st_as_sfc(OSW_shp[OSW_shp$group==unique(OSW_shp$group)[i],]))
    gr_group_xy[[i]] = st_coordinates(gr_group[[i]])
  }
  names(gr_group) = unique(OSW_shp$group)
  names(gr_group_xy) = unique(OSW_shp$group)
  
  
  #Now calculate the density performance metrics 
  # sp_PM = Dens_dif %>%
  #   filter(year == Term.year) %>%
  #   mutate(Max_df = max(abs(Dif))) %>%
  #   mutate(Dif = (Dif/Max_df)) %>%
  #   group_by(scen, X, Y) %>%
  #   summarise(Dif = mean(Dif)) %>%
  #   select(X, Y, scen, Dif) %>%
  #   ungroup()
  sp_PM = Dens_dif %>%
  #group_by(scen, X, Y) %>%
  #summarise(Dif = mean(Dif)) %>% ungroup() %>%
  filter(year == Term.year) %>%
  #mutate(Max_df = max(abs(Dif))) %>%
  #mutate(Dif = (Dif/Max_df)) %>%
  group_by(scen, X, Y) %>%
  summarise(Dif = mean(Dif)) %>%
  select(X, Y, scen, Dif) %>%
  ungroup()
  # 
  gr_pred_dif = bind_rows(lapply(split(sp_PM, sp_PM$scen), function(x){
    pred_points <- x %>%
      dplyr::select(X,Y) %>% as.matrix()
    nns <- nn2(pred_points,gr_xy,k=1)$nn.idx
    gr_pred <- gr_xy %>% as_tibble() %>% mutate(Dif=x$Dif[nns])
    gr_pred$scen = x$scen[1]
    return(gr_pred)
  }))
  
  gr_pred_dif_OSW = bind_rows(lapply(split(sp_PM, sp_PM$scen), function(x){
    scen_list = list()
    for(i in 1:length(gr_group_xy)){
      pred_points <- x %>%
        dplyr::select(X,Y) %>% as.matrix()
      nns <- nn2(pred_points,gr_group_xy[[i]],k=1)$nn.idx
      gr_pred <- gr_group_xy[[i]] %>% as_tibble() %>% mutate(Dif=x$Dif[nns])
      gr_pred$scen = x$scen[1]
      gr_pred$OSW = names(gr_group_xy)[i]
      scen_list[[i]] = gr_pred
    }
    return(bind_rows(scen_list))
  }))
  ## Plots 
  
  gr_pred_dif$scen = factor(gr_pred_dif$scen,
                            levels = lev_scen)#Assign the levels 
  
  gr_pred_dif_OSW$scen = factor(gr_pred_dif_OSW$scen,
                                levels = lev_scen)#Assign the levels 
  
  
  # Entire range 
  Den_ER_plot = ggplot(Coast)+
    geom_sf()+
    geom_tile(data = gr_pred_dif, aes(x=X, y=Y, ,fill = Dif))+
    facet_wrap(~scen)+
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#0571b0",
                         mid = "#f7f7f7",
                         high = "#ca0020",
                         limits = c(min(gr_pred_dif$Dif),
                                    max(gr_pred_dif$Dif))) +
    labs(x = "", y="") + 
    theme_classic()+
    xlim(min(gr_pred_dif$X),
         max(gr_pred_dif$X))+
    ylim(min(gr_pred_dif$Y),
         max(gr_pred_dif$Y))+
    geom_sf(data = OSW_shp, fill = 'transparent', colour = 'black', lwd = .1)+
    theme(axis.text = element_text(size = 5))
  
  ## Different areas 
  range_x = list()
  for(i in 1:length(unique(gr_pred_dif_OSW$OSW))){
    range_x[[i]] = abs(gr_pred_dif_OSW %>%
                         filter(OSW == unique(OSW_shp$group)[i]) %>%
                         select(X) %>%
                         summarise(min = min(X)) -
                         gr_pred_dif_OSW %>%
                         filter(OSW == unique(OSW_shp$group)[i]) %>%
                         select(X) %>%
                         summarise(max = max(X))) 
  }
  Max_range=max(unlist(range_x))
  
  range_y = list()
  for(i in 1:length(unique(gr_pred_dif_OSW$OSW))){
    range_y[[i]] = abs(gr_pred_dif_OSW %>%
                         filter(OSW == unique(OSW_shp$group)[i]) %>%
                         select(Y) %>%
                         summarise(max = max(Y)) -
                         gr_pred_dif_OSW %>%
                         filter(OSW == unique(OSW_shp$group)[i]) %>%
                         select(Y) %>%
                         summarise(min = min(Y))) 
  }
  Max_range_y=max(unlist(range_y))
  
  Dif_plots = list()
  
  for(i in 1:length(unique(gr_pred_dif_OSW$OSW))){
    w = gr_pred_dif_OSW[gr_pred_dif_OSW$OSW %in% unique(gr_pred_dif_OSW$OSW)[i],]
    Dif_plots[[i]] = ggplot()+
      geom_tile(data = w, aes(x=X, y=Y, ,fill = Dif))+
      facet_nested(OSW~scen)+
      scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#0571b0",
                           mid = "#f7f7f7",
                           high = "#ca0020",
                           limits = c(min(gr_pred_dif$Dif),
                                      max(gr_pred_dif$Dif))) +
      theme_classic()+
      labs(x = "", y="") +
      xlim(mean(w$X) - Max_range/2,
           mean(w$X) + Max_range/2)+
      ylim(ifelse((median(w$Y) - Max_range_y/1.95)<min(w$Y), 
                  (median(w$Y) - Max_range_y/1.95),
                  min(w$Y)),
           median(w$Y) + Max_range_y/1.95)+
      geom_sf(data = OSW_shp, fill = 'transparent', colour = 'black', lwd = .75)+
      theme(axis.text = element_blank(),
            axis.line = element_blank(),
            axis.ticks = element_blank(),
            axis.title = element_blank())
  }
 
  dif_avg = gr_pred_dif_OSW %>%
    group_by(scen, OSW) %>%
    summarise(Avg = mean(Dif))

  return(list(Density_dif_ER = gr_pred_dif,
              Density_dif_OSW = gr_pred_dif_OSW,
              Dif_plot_ER = Den_ER_plot,
              Dif_plot_OSW = Dif_plots,
              Dif = dif_avg))
}

saveRDS(Dens_Prc_Change_func.b, paste0(WD.1, "/Functions/Dens_perc_change_func_b.rds"))#Index function
```
